01 / GEOSPATIAL & MACHINE LEARNINGResearch project

Bengaluru Heat Atlas

An interactive look at urban surface heat. I combined satellite imagery, weather data and machine learning to map 1,320 cells and identify 73 connected hotspot clusters across Bengaluru.

Models trained on 2022–2025 observations support a January–May 2026 atlas, with environmental indicators and potential cooling strategies.

  • Python
  • Earth Engine
  • scikit-learn
  • Leaflet
  • GitHub Actions

02 / FULL-STACK & AI-ASSISTED GUIDANCEWeb application

CAREVA

A career-guidance platform for students and graduates. It connects skills and interests with role recommendations, skill-gap analysis and a personalised learning roadmap.

Built with assessments, saved progress, user accounts and contextual coaching. Optional Mistral integration adds AI-assisted conversations.

Technical curiosity.

I’m Rohan, a Computer Science and Information Technology student at REVA University in Bengaluru.

I’m interested in how software, AI and data can solve practical problems. My work ranges from backend development and career guidance to understanding urban heat through satellite observations.

Alongside technology, I’ve explored product management, social media and community engagement. Those experiences shape how I think about people, communication and the things I build.
